# Horus Flow

> Live crypto market microstructure and US equity session context for AI agents, served as a remote MCP server and a REST API. Every directional reading carries its own measured hit rate.

## Connect
- Remote MCP (Streamable HTTP): https://flow.horustek.pro/mcp
- Auth: header `X-API-Key: <key>` or `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Without a key: free tier.
- REST base: https://flow.horustek.pro  (OpenAPI: https://flow.horustek.pro/api/openapi.json)
- Status: https://flow.horustek.pro/v1/status

## What it provides
- Order flow for any Binance spot pair: 5s and 30s aggressive buy/sell delta in USD, top-20 order book depth ratio, large trades relative to the pair's 24h volume.
- Derivatives for 10 majors (BTC, ETH, SOL, XRP, BNB, DOGE, ADA, AVAX, LINK, SUI): funding and open interest across Binance, Bybit and OKX; futures/spot volume vs its 7-day median; crowd long/short vs its 24h median; estimated liquidation levels; liquidations seen in the last 5 minutes.
- Horus Cortex: BTC regime, trust score, contradictions between evidence families.
- Ignition scanner: breakout conditions across ~750 assets, refreshed every minute.
- US equities: session phase, holidays, early closes, next open/close, active trading halts (Nasdaq Trader); flow from the IEX feed, which is a sample of about 3% of US volume.
- Cross-asset: BTC flow next to SPY, QQQ, COIN, MSTR and IBIT.
- Events: liquidation cascades, regime changes, composite changes, new halts; by polling, Server-Sent Events or signed webhooks.

## How to weigh the signals
- `reliability.hit_rate` is measured live since August 2026 at 1, 5, 15 and 30 minutes. Many signals are close to 50% (a coin flip). Use them as context, not as trade instructions.
- Every response reports its data age (`freshness_ms`). Endpoints return HTTP 503 `data_stale` rather than old data.
- Full numbers: https://flow.horustek.pro/v1/track-record ; per-signal ledger for backtests: /v1/track-record/signals

## Free tier
BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT flow, track record, US session and halts, service status.

## Not financial advice
Horus Flow provides market data and measured statistics. It does not manage money or give personalized advice.
